notes.title: Buy Black Book with 15% Launch Discount!
notes.notes:
Day 222 of 2021...The Black Book opens. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35642483/4ebc2c8ebf5b3bdd973d129e04552a4f3db0df94.gif[/img]

We are super happy to announce that Black Book is now officially fully released on Steam and nearly all other platforms! The game features 150k words worth of voiced English and Russian dialogue, 20+ hours of exciting gameplay, a number of different endings, many tales and insights into Cherdyn’s culture and rituals, and much more. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

What’s more, you can enjoy not one but two games set in a dark, mysterious and mythical setting: Black Book and Stoneshard. Check out our Pave Your Own Path Bundle for a nice discount on both! 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22263/Pave_Your_Own_Path_Bundle/

Now, it is up to you to determine how our main protagonist, Vasilisa, will journey across her homeland and beyond. Follow along on her adventures and steel yourself, for the night is dark...and full of demons. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35642483/5e6a0d8917b75a4944da4e08a3958b0ea68c4b67.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22262/Black_Book__Supporter_Bundle/

There’s also a Supporter Pack available for Black Book, with the game’s full soundtrack, awesome artbook, and an extra skin for Vasilisa’s character.

See you in Cherdyn!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/

notes.title: Black Book is Coming Out on Aug 10, 2021
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=EmNonUpfkhM;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone!

Black Book came a fairly long way to this point: we ran a successful Kickstarter campaign, launched the prologue, and spent lots of time developing and polishing the game over the past year. You, in turn, have been supporting us all the way, inspiring us to keep working tirelessly. It’s been a long, sometimes tough, yet exciting and fruitful road — and this road is finally coming to a finish line now. 

[h3]We’re extremely delighted to announce that Black Book will be launching on all platforms on August 10 @ 10AM PT, which happens to be the 222nd day of the year 2021! 
[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35642483/b10f81a1ebacea054b6c3756e3716f4b38cbeb8d.jpg[/img]

[i]Actually, this may come as no surprise for those of you who have been actively following us here/on Twitter — remember our last 3 posts with random (at first glance) pictures? Well, those posts were the hints — try looking at them with the information you’ve got now, you’ll be quite surprised, promise :)[/i]

The game will cost $24.99 (€24.99, £19.99), and you will be able to get it with a 15% discount during the first week after the release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35642483/ccfb47696f42c407d4c9a39a8614a3abf87f0dfa.gif[/img]

Black Book will feature a full English voiceover, extensive story dialogues consisting of more than 150k words, and more than 20 hours of gameplay. Also, there’ll be a Supporter pack available for $10, including soundtrack and digital artbook. Exciting, right?

We hope that you’re looking forward to the release as much as we are — we can assure you that this long wait has been worth it. Really, you’ll see it for yourself very soon!

[h2]Here is what you can do if you don't want to miss the release: [/h2]

[olist]

notes.title: Announcing our new game - Black Book, an Adventure RPG!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27768439/c232d544eee0d9272c74eb1dfaf90441c65ab82e.jpg[/img]

[b]Hey everyone![/b]
First off, I’d like to thank all of you for the warm reception for our first title, The Mooseman.
It was great seeing all of the interest and positive comments on the game we have worked so hard on.
Today, we’re announcing the next project from the Morteshka team: a story-driven RPG called Black Book.
→[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/]Steam Page[/url]←

[h3]WHAT IS THE BLACK BOOK?[/h3]
Black Book is an RPG/Adventure game, where you take on the role of a young witch named Vasilisa. As you explore the small towns and villages of early XXth century Russia, you’ll face iconic creatures from Russian mythology. Some will aid you on your way, or even join you on your journey; others will threaten your body and soul - and you’ll get to battle them using a card-based combat system.

[h3]WHAT IS THE GAME’S STORY?[/h3]
At a young age, Vasilisa stepped forth onto the path to witchhood - and started
learning under an experienced sorcerer, known across the land for aiding folk in need.
During her training, Vasya met a young man, and immediately fell in love. She decided to stop her pursuits and marry him - but her dreams are shattered when her betrothed dies under mysterious circumstances.
To revive her deceased love, Vasilisa needs to unlock the seven seals of the Black Book - a centuries-old artifact, passed down from Witches of the past.
Throughout the game, she will come face-to-face with the destructive influence of black magic. Will she surrender to dark forces and become a lost witch - or will she atone for selling her soul to the dark?

[h3]WHERE CAN I LEARN MORE ABOUT THE GAME?[/h3]
If you want to know more about Black Book, following us on social media is the best way to keep up with t	he latest news!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1138660/Black_Book/
Find us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/playblackbook
Like us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/Playblackbook
Join our Discord server: https://discord.gg/Nue8s4
Anyway, that’s all for now. You should expect to hear a lot more from us further on, so stay tuned.

Thanks for reading!
-- Vladimir

notes.notes: The Mooseman [official site] is another one of those games which caught my eye for its colour palette – greyscale plus teal – but then went on to sound legit interesting in the description field. notes.title: The Mooseman Release Date, Price and More
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27768439/573157cf1e4e197d8c5e19426e1bc48d539558c2.jpg[/img]

Hey everyone!

Vladimir here to tell you about why we make a release at 17th of February exactly, what will be the price and such stuff.

Our game is dedicated to the pagan finno-ugric mythology of ancient permian tribes, local to the town that our small team lives in (Perm, Russia). Mythology was materialized in bronze casted objects, with a unique style, called Perm Animal Style and these artefacts were the foremost inspiration for the game. All these myths that the object depict were lost during christianization process, so we had to reconstruct them, and we did that as best as we could. 

The descendants of these so called Chud' tribes are now known as Komi-Permians. It is their ancestors who created all the bronze animal style objects.  So the date of the release was chosen for a reason. [b]17th February[/b] is the day celebrating the Komi-Permian language, which now slowly disappears from regular use. We will celebrate it by remembering all the old stories and beliefs, that our game strives to bring forward from the sands of time.

Our game is a hobby-project, so the duration is short, about couple of hours, maybe 3 if you will collect all the secrets (which are kind of cryptic) and read all stories. The game will go live on [b]17th February[/b] for [b]6.99$[/b]. 

Thank you for stopping by to read our announcement and hope to see you in the ancient worlds of pagan myth!

--Vladimir
